news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹3.96 (vs ₹0.23 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹3.96 (up from ₹0.23 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹46.1m (up 208% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹22.0m (up ₹23.3m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 48% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 116% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 104% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Sandeep Jain, Vikas Garg, Rahul Nagar and Himanshu Arora agreed to acquire 58.15% stake in Pankaj Polymers Limited (BSE:531280) from group of shareholders.
news.body: Sandeep Jain, Vikas Garg, Rahul Nagar and Himanshu Arora agreed to acquire 58.15% stake in Pankaj Polymers Limited (BSE:531280) from group of shareholders on January 14, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by the buyer.

news.title: Pankaj Polymers Limited Announces Appointment of Ms. Nupur Garg as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 10, 2026
news.body: Pankaj Polymers Limited appointed Ms. Nupur Garg (M.No. A19874) as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective from January 10, 2026. The appointment was approved at the Board Meeting held on January 10, 2026. Ms. Nupur Garg (M. No. A19874) is a qualified Company Secretary with practical exposure to corporate, secretarial and statutory compliances under various corporate laws.
